root_cause.text: The root cause is the presence of sysfs bind attributes on the reset-gpio auxiliary driver, which allows userspace to unbind the device prematurely, triggering a use-after-free when reset control handles are released.
root_cause.evidence: The patch modifies `drivers/reset/reset-gpio.c` to set `.suppress_bind_attrs = true` in the `reset_gpio_driver` structure, and the commit message explicitly states that unbinding the device causes a "use-after-free splat from any user that puts the reset control handle" because the device is intended to "stay in memory forever" without a devlink to manage consumer lifecycles.
